summary: The change replaces the blanket json_syntax relabel with closed rejection categories that retain the strict parser category and native recovery or check stage, while keeping raw text out of unavailable results and preserving fail-closed acceptance.

evidence: `src/github/native-review-result.ts` wraps envelope, binding, result, and native-findings rejections with the recovery flag and exposes closed rejection categories
`src/github/reviewer-outcome.ts` uses those categories only for the static malformed detail and still returns unavailable with null result and execution after rejection

`tests/github/native-review-diagnostics_test.ts` covers strict and recovered envelope, binding, result, and native-findings stages, oversized and missing diagnostics, category-only durable publication, fresh reads, and exactly one charged turn
No raw model output is retained or published, and no parser, binding, model, effort, schema, CI, custody, or accounting gate is relaxed
